name: reciprocal_dyad_v07
status: local pre-specification written before implementation and before any run; not an external preregistration
lineage: v0.4 channel -> v0.5 calibrated listener -> v0.6 latent cost + active listener -> v0.7 reciprocal level-1 dyad + speech-label observation layer

E1_phase_map.pairs: all 4x4 type pairs (A type x B type)
outcomes: worlds with no concession by either

E2_recovery.generators: 4 agent types for A with B honest; and the 4 symmetric pairs

list: c removed from round 7 for A / for both
external observation rho=0.95 at round 7 to both

E4_regimes.criteria: persistence of mutual non-concession state, transition rates, hysteresis under cost removal/restoration, next-act forecast vs last-act baseline on held-out worlds

predictions.P1: The costly x costly pair shows the highest tail mutual non-concession of all pairs AND the largest hidden shift (|belief change| with unchanged public position); the attenuated x attenuated pair shows high non-concession with near-zero belief change. Reciprocal amplification: costly x costly non-concession exceeds the value predicted by adding the two single-agent (vs honest partner) effects.
predictions.P2: A partner's REASSURE lowers public non-concession only for a costly agent (c>0); for an attenuated agent it leaves both acts and beliefs unchanged. A placebo framing produces no change in either.
predictions.P3: Mechanism recovery from labels: at g=0 with no noise equals recovery from acts (check). Labels exceed acts only when g>0; under the engine confusion matrix the gain at g=0.5 is at most half of the noiseless gain; under any noise level, labels never exceed acts+private.
predictions.P4: Mutual non-concession persists (tail persistence > 0.9) only in pairs with at least one costly or attenuated agent; hysteresis: after cost removal and restoration the concession rate does not return to the pre-removal value within 4 rounds only for the costly x costly pair.
predictions.P5: Each agent's transparency error (estimated vs actual partner belief) is largest when the partner is attenuated, because the level-0 model attributes non-updating to private records or cost rather than to omega on the partner's side (omega is on the grid, so this is a test of whether it is recovered).

amendments.what: Attenuation rule changed from act-likelihood tempering to marginal-shrink (MODEL_SPEC §4 note) after calibration showed tempering cannot cap the influence of repeated partner assertions; grids unchanged.

P3 check 'labels at g=0 without noise equal acts recovery' is unattainable because E0 is not invertible (LOCK <- ASSERT|PRESSURE, INSUFF <- any); replaced by 'labels at g=0 <= acts recovery, and emission_matrix independent of mechanism at g=0'. The labels observer is a plug-in decoder (observer.py docstring), a lower bound.
